Fukoku Mutual Life Insurance Company sold 11,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 18.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6,900 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $284,000, down from 18,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fukoku Mutual Life Insurance Company who had been investing in Micron Technology Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $55.18 billion market cap company.
